package sample

func chooseBySwitch(x int) int {
	switch {
	case x > 0, x == 99:
		return 1
	case x < 0:
		return -1
	case x == 0:
		return 0
	default:
		return 2
	}
}

func chooseByIf(x int) int {
	if x > 0 {
		return 1
	} else if x < 0 {
		return -1
	}
	return 0
}

func chooseByFallthrough(x int) int {
	switch {
	case x > 0:
		fallthrough
	case x == 99:
		return 3
	default:
		return 0
	}
}
